senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; אחה; cmp. אָב)brother, kinsman; fellow, equal, fellow-believer &c.
units: Meg. 11ᵃ (play on ăhashverosh, Ahasverus) אָׄחִׄיו ש̇ל ר̇אש̇ וכ׳ a brother (in cruelty) to the chief tyrant (Nebucadn.); a. fr.—Pl. אַחִים, אַחִין.
Gen. R. s. 89, beg. (play on āḥu, Gen. XLI, 2) in years of plenty הבריות נעשו א׳ וכ׳ people are brotherly to each other.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:8">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> <he>אחים דפחתא וכ׳</he> brothers to the degraded woman (Dinah), … but not to Joseph; a. fr.—
Cant. R. to VIII, 1 שני אחים brother and sister
